    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ResolvedMerge_Resolved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Resolved_FeedbackDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackDecision" name="Feedback provided?" default="Flow_NoFeedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Resolved_FeedbackDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackGiven</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_Feedback" name="Customer satisfaction feedback received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackGiven</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback_FeedbackMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackMerge" name="Feedback step concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Feedback_FeedbackMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackMerge_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Resolved" name="Complaint resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackMerge_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Logged" sourceRef="StartEvent_ComplaintFiled" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Logged_Assigned" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignDepartment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assigned_Investigate" sourceRef="Task_AssignDepartment" targetRef="Task_Investigate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Investigate_Decision" sourceRef="Task_Investigate" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundApproved" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyApproval">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundApproved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundRejected" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_Process" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyApproval" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Process_Send" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="SendTask_SendRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_ResolvedMerge" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRefund" targetRef="Gateway_ResolvedMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejection_ResolvedMerge" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyRejection" targetRef="Gateway_ResolvedMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResolvedMerge_Resolved" sourceRef="Gateway_ResolvedMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Resolved_FeedbackDecision" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackGiven" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackDecision" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_Feedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${feedbackGiven == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFeedback" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackDecision" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_FeedbackMerge" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_Feedback" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackMerge_End" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_Resolved"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Complaint" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/complaint-handling">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DecisionApproved" name="Refund approved notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DecisionRejected" name="Refund rejected notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RefundSent" name="Refund sent"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Satisfaction feedback"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DecisionApproved" name="Refund approved notification" messageRef="Msg_DecisionApproved" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyApproval" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DecisionRejected" name="Refund rejected notification" messageRef="Msg_DecisionRejected" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyRejection" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Complaint Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Complaint">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ResolvedMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FeedbackDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FeedbackMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Resolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RelevantDepartment" name="Relevant Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Investigate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_NotifyApproval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_NotifyRejection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FinancialTeam" name="Financial Team">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_SendRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_FileComplaint</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_FileComplaint" name="File complaint">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_FileComplaint</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FileComplaint_Logged</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Logged_Assigned</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignDepartment" name="Assign complaint to relevant department">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assigned_Investigate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Investigate" name="Review details and determine validity and refund justification">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Investigate_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_RefundRejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Investigate_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefundApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefundRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyApproval" name="Notify customer of refund approval" messageRef="Msg_DecisionApproved">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_Process</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessRefund" name="Process reimbursement">

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRefund" name="Send refund to customer" messageRef="Msg_RefundSent">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Send_ResolvedMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyRejection" name="Notify customer of refund rejection" messageRef="Msg_DecisionRejected">

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejection_ResolvedMerge</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Resolved_FeedbackDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackDecision" name="Feedback provided?" default="Flow_NoFeedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Resolved_FeedbackDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackGiven</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_Feedback" name="Customer satisfaction feedback received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackGiven</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback_FeedbackMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackMerge" name="Feedback step concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Feedback_FeedbackMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackMerge_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Resolved" name="Complaint resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackMerge_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_FileComplaint" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_FileComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FileComplaint_Logged" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Logged_Assigned" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignDepartment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assigned_Investigate" sourceRef="Task_AssignDepartment" targetRef="Task_Investigate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Investigate_Decision" sourceRef="Task_Investigate" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundApproved" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyApproval">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundApproved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundRejected" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_Process" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyApproval" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Process_Send" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="SendTask_SendRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_ResolvedMerge" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRefund" targetRef="Gateway_ResolvedMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejection_ResolvedMerge" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyRejection" targetRef="Gateway_ResolvedMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResolvedMerge_Resolved" sourceRef="Gateway_ResolvedMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Resolved_FeedbackDecision" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackGiven" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackDecision" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_Feedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${feedbackGiven == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFeedback" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackDecision" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_FeedbackMerge" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_Feedback" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackMerge_End" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_Resolved"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states an optional action that a party may take after the main outcome has been reached, and that action is not a separate process trigger: Do not model the optional later action with its own start event, since a start event has no incoming flow and would sit detached from the main flow. Instead, join it to the main flow: place a decision gateway where the main outcome is reached, with one branch that waits for the optional action through an intermediate catch event and then continues to the end event, and another branch that skips the action and goes straight to the end event. Both branches must reconnect so that every element lies on one connected path from the start event.
rules.situation: the description states an optional action that a party may take after the main outcome has been reached, and that action is not a separate process trigger

rules.instruction: When the description has a decision whose one outcome requires an extra action before the common later step, while the other outcome skips that action, and both outcomes lead to the same following step or end: Model the decision as an exclusive split. Place the extra action as its own task on the branch that requires it. Keep the skipping outcome as a direct flow from the split, with no task on it. Join both paths with an exclusive merge gateway placed before the common following step or end event. Do not let the path with the action flow straight into the common step while the skipping path bypasses the merge, and do not drop the action on either branch.
rules.situation: the description has a decision whose one outcome requires an extra action before the common later step, while the other outcome skips that action, and both outcomes lead to the same following step or end

rules.instruction: When the description states a named action that is performed right after a choice or acceptance outcome (for example, a selected or agreed result) and before a further phase, a branch or a parallel start begins, even when that action is only a short phrase such as an invitation or the beginning of a phase: Model that stated action as a task placed directly after the step or gateway that produces the outcome, with a sequence flow from that outcome into the task and a sequence flow from the task to the next element the description names. Do not drop the action or let the gateway or the following phase stand for it.
rules.situation: the description states a determination whose outcomes are each communicated or acted on in a different described way, for example one outcome leads to a further processing step while another leads directly to a notification and the end of the case

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant performs an action that is a step of the process, such as communicating an outcome to another party or collecting feedback from a party, and that action happens on only one branch of a decision or after the main work is done: Model each such performed action as a task, placed on every branch where the description states it occurs and in the order the description gives. Do not replace the performed action with an intermediate throw or catch event. Reserve intermediate events for occurrences the process waits for or reacts to.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant performs an action that is a step of the process, such as communicating an outcome to another party or collecting feedback from a party, and that action happens on only one branch of a decision or after the main work is done

rules.instruction: When the description states that an evaluation leads to an exclusive decision whose two outcomes each require a different follow-up action, and both outcomes include an action of the same general kind (for example, informing a party) but with different content: Model the evaluation as a task, then an exclusive split gateway. Place a separate task on each outcome branch, each carrying that outcome's own action, including the shared-kind action worded for that outcome. Do not place one combined task before the split that stands for both outcomes. Join the branches with an exclusive merge gateway before the next common step, so that the outcome-specific action of each branch is kept in the model.
rules.situation: the description states that an evaluation leads to an exclusive decision whose two outcomes each require a different follow-up action, and both outcomes include an action of the same general kind (for example, informing a party) but with different content

rules.instruction: When the description says the process begins when an actor performs an action (for example, identifying a need), and that action is a work step the actor carries out before the main flow continues: Model a generic start event with no label that repeats the action. Model the actor's action as a task that follows the start event and precedes the next step of the flow, so the performed work stays visible as an activity. Do not label the start event with the action itself.
rules.situation: the description states that the process begins when an actor performs a described action (for example filing a request), and then describes further work that follows that action
